messages:
Incident-bot: PAGER -> @oncall | P1 | service=rate-limiter | tag=deploy,canary | detected: elevated 429s & 5xx in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-15T11:56Z
Maya: noticing spike on dashboards — new rollout started ~11:52 UTC (rlv2 exemptions change)
Jonah: yep, dashboards + logs = exemptions lookup returning empty for many accounts. 429s for customers with explicit exemptions (weird)
SRE-bot: tail logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T11:53:10Z rate-limiter ERROR apply_exemptions account=acct-900 err="expected array, got null"
2026-03-15T11:53:11Z token-ledger WARN checkpoint=chk_777 mismatch expected=4500 actual=4478
```
Maya: incoming support alerts from Vault-Enterprise, Syncly, and PaperTrail. Olivia, any CSM/SE chatter?
Olivia: SEs on calls with Vault-Enterprise and Syncly, both report timeouts and blocked write requests. CSM notified, asking for ETA.
Prateek: i kicked off the canary rollout at 11:52 for rlv2_exemptions schema change. Canary at 15% now. Rolling up automatically.
Maya: mitigation brainstorm: 1) flip the feature-flag kill-switch 2) pause rollout 3) rollback binary 4) hotfix to handle null exemptions
Jonah: safest immediate is kill-switch/pause so we stop touching new hosts. Then rollback if errors persist.
Prateek: i'm on it, executing kill-switch for eu-west-1 now:
```
redwoodctl flag flip --name rlv2_exemptions --state off --region eu-west-1 --by prateek
```
Deploy-bot: flag rlv2_exemptions set to OFF in eu-west-1 by prateek at 11:59 UTC — draining canary targets
SRE-bot: telemetry update: 2m after flip 429s down ~55%, but some accounts still experiencing transient failures due to token-ledger replay backlog
Jonah: ledger process logs show repeated checkpoint replays during canary which caused retry storms. Need to avoid cascading backpressure.
Maya: Prateek can you pause+rollback the deploy group? We'll prefer full rollback to previous stable binary, not just flag.
Prateek: starting rollback of deploy group rate-limiter-eu -> target revision 20260314_180
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --group rate-limiter-eu --to 20260314_180 --reason "exemptions-null-regression"
```
Deploy-bot: rollback initiated, estimated completion ~3-5m
SRE-bot: watchlist: apply_exemptions, token-ledger.sync, and user-facing 429s. Posting rolling log tail:
```
11:59:58 apply_exemptions OK account=acct-900
12:00:10 token-ledger.sync INFO replayed=300 pending=120
12:00:22 token-ledger.sync ERROR checkpoint=chk_777 mismatch
```
Olivia: Vault-Enterprise CSM confirmed temporary bypass accepted: we routed critical workflows through a bypass proxy and gave a quota lift for 20 minutes. Syncly accepted partial mitigation.
Support-bot: created incident doc & runbook: https://confluence/incidents/rlv2-exemptions-2026-03-15 | linked tickets: #2345, #2346, #2347
Maya: handing over oncall to Prateek — i have a customer webcast in 8m. Prateek -> Jonah handoff in 10m for post-rollback monitoring.
Prateek: i'm owner, will watch rollback completion and confirm steady-state. saving logs and host list to evidence bucket.
SRE-bot: rollback finished at 12:03 UTC; post-rollback health checks show majority traffic recovered. 429s back to baseline ~6m after rollback.
Jonah: verification: exemptions look present again and apply_exemptions returns OK for sampled accounts. token-ledger caught up after ledger replay with no data loss.
Olivia: customer impact summary for execs: Vault-Enterprise ~14m degraded for key APIs; Syncly ~10m partial degradation; PaperTrail ~5m intermittent. SEs escalated but no SLA monetary breach yet.
Maya: draft exec blurb:
- Incident: canary deploy introduced null/exemptions regression causing over-throttling in eu-west-1
- Impact: elevated 429s impacting several large customers; mitigated by kill-switch and full rollback
- Timeline high level: deploy ~11:52 -> pager 11:56 -> kill-switch 11:59 -> rollback 12:00 -> recovery ~12:06
- Next steps: mandatory pre-deploy schema validation for exemptions, add canary-only smoke test to simulate exemption matches, implement a token-ledger circuit-breaker to avoid replay-induced backpressure
Prateek: logging action items: collect failing host IDs, attach logs, prepare hotfix PR to guard null exemptions and add unit tests. assigning proto-postmortem to Maya + Prateek.
Support-bot: postmortem assigned to Maya and Prateek, severity=P1, due in 72h.
Jonah: followups: add automated canary pause threshold if 429s exceed x% and implement faster kill-switch propagation for flags.
Maya: i'll own the postmortem writeup. marking this thread resolved unless new alerts surface. :thumbsup:
